items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Yeah, well it was his wife, Gladys, because she wouldn’t let him have any money because he’d go out on a drunk.

ctx.x: Yeah I’ve heard Hamp was a little tight fisted.

Yeah, well it was his wife, Gladys, because she wouldn’t let him have any money because he’d go out on a drunk. One time, when Curtis was with the band, one of the times he said that they were always after Gladys. They said, “Gladys, it’s embarrassing. We go out to a nightclub after we finish our dance engagement, and Hamp orders up, and he doesn’t have any money to pay for it. Gee you’ve got to give him an allowance or something.” So one day Hampton got a hold of one of the recording checks. And he disappeared…
